arStrings.szText: Casting {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} on an {c_important}Earthquake{/c} explodes for their total damage and are consumed, and also causes your {c_important}Hammer of the Ancients{/c} to deal {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|2%x|]{/c} increased damage for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.
